verdict.rationale: Cactus is built for on-device inference: the vendor states "no GPU, no server, and no data leaving the device" (docs-24), documents local runs on macOS, Linux and Windows without a GPU (docs-11), and ships a local CLI via brew install and cactus run (gh-6). Community users report fast offline inference on phones and desktops (comm-13, comm-12, comm-19). The product also offers automatic cloud routing of hard queries based on local confidence (gh-3), so fully local operation depends on how it is configured. missing for 10: clear documentation of whether cloud routing is opt-in or how to disable it, and independent verification of no telemetry or network egress during local inference.
